title: Gaia Solar System — Gates as Planets, Latency as Orbit
note: eastGate = SUN. Latency (ms) = orbital radius (AU). Primals = atmosphere. eSIM = moons to capture. NON-SELF = asteroids/comets.

sun.name: eastGate
sun.temperature: HOT — 48ms avg response, 35 crons = solar flares

planets.name: MikroTik
planets.note: Closest to sun, smallest, fastest orbit. Password unknown.

planets.name: northGate
planets.mass: 96GB RAM, 16384 CUDA cores, 63 ollama models, 73 CPU cores
planets.atmosphere: THICK — biomeOS nucleus, git push circuit
planets.note: Brightest planet. Pushes via git, no SSH from mesh. THE HEART of the organism.

planets.name: sporeGate
planets.atmosphere: breathable — DNS + heart-pull active every 2 min
planets.note: The living planet. Heart-pull = tides. DNS = magnetic field.

planets.name: Router
planets.role: GL-MT6000 — gateway, NTP, DHCP, port forwards
planets.mass: All WAN traffic passes through. Port forwards 80/443/25/53 → eastGate.
planets.atmosphere: thin — NTP server, 2 WiFi bands (Aperture Science + Black Mesa)
planets.note: The red gateway. All ingress/egress passes through Mars.

planets.name: JetStream
planets.role: TP-Link managed switch — 10G fiber bridge to House 2
planets.note: The belt between inner and outer system. 10G spine connecting two houses.

planets.name: ironGate
planets.note: Gas giant. Most mass after the sun. Full tower workstation.

planets.name: deckGate
planets.role: DISPLAY — Steam Deck v1, mounted display
planets.rings_note: USB-C permanent passthrough (dead battery = RINGS of power cable)
planets.note: Ringed planet. The mounted display. Dead battery = permanent orbit (no escape velocity).

planets.name: graftGate
planets.rings_note: Tilted on its side (Mac Mini form factor)
planets.note: Tilted ice giant. Needs physical power-on.

planets.name: southGate
planets.note: The far ice giant. Home phone pinned to property = stable distant orbit.

planets.name: grapheneGate
planets.role: DIAMOND LENS — Pixel 8a, 37 sensors, Mali-G715 Vulkan
planets.atmosphere: thin — WiFi only, crosses between houses
planets.note: Dwarf planet with eccentric orbit (WiFi variance). Carries Kevin = Charon. eSIM = telecom relay.

planets.name: frameGate
planets.mass: Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, first ARM SteamOS node
planets.note: Trans-Neptunian object. THE FACE. Shows what the brain thinks. THE SKY = this screen.

planets.name: swiftGate
planets.role: HEART (LAN 2) — NZXT H1 V2, RTX 3070, WiFi-only
planets.note: Most distant known object. ASLEEP. Needs Kevin to wake. Extreme aphelion.

planets.name: blueGate
planets.note: Predicted but not seen. Gravitational influence felt (Cursor IDE was here). Needs physical search.
